description: Vite bundle splitting - Add manual chunks configuration to split the massive 810KB Dashboard chunk and reduce initial load. Split recharts, @heroui/react, @hello-pangea/dnd, framer-motion, and simple-statistics into separate vendor chunks so they can be cached independently and loaded on demand.
steps: In config/vite.config.ts, add build.rollupOptions.output.manualChunks configuration to split: (1) 'vendor-recharts' for recharts, (2) 'vendor-motion' for framer-motion, (3) 'vendor-heroui' for @heroui/react, (4) 'vendor-dnd' for @hello-pangea/dnd, (5) 'vendor-stats' for simple-statistics. This splits the Dashboard's 810KB chunk since the majority of it is these libraries bundled together.
Add build.chunkSizeWarningLimit: 600 to suppress the warning for the vendor-recharts chunk (recharts alone is large), while keeping warnings for app code.
Verify the build output shows smaller individual chunks instead of one massive Dashboard chunk.
acceptance_criteria: The Dashboard chunk (application code only) is under 500KB
Vendor libraries are in their own chunks that can be cached independently
verification: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && pnpm run build 2>&1 | grep -E '(Dashboard|vendor|chunk)'
findings: Dashboard chunk reduced from 810KB to 44KB. Vendor chunks: recharts 434KB, heroui 249KB, framer-motion 137KB, dnd 85KB, stats 2KB. Pre-existing test failure in sound.test.ts (not RankingAdjustment as noted in context). No new failures introduced.
